ruleDefinitions.name: DLL Execution Via Register-cimprovider.exe
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects using register-cimprovider.exe to execute arbitrary dll file.

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\\\register\\-cimprovider\\\.exe$") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-path.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*dll.*")))
